We saw above that our construction of <MATH_0001>,
resp.<SPACE_0001><MATH_0002> gives a sheaf of <MATH_0003>-algebras, resp.<SPACE_0002><MATH_0004>-modules.
Hence we get a morphism by
Schemes, Lemma <REF_0001>.
This morphism, when restricted to <MATH_0005> comes from the
canonical ring map <MATH_0006>. The maps
<MATH_0007>, <MATH_0008> are <MATH_0009>-algebra maps, see
Lemma <REF_0002>.
Hence if the homogeneous prime <MATH_0010>
corresponds to the <MATH_0011>-graded prime <MATH_0012>
and the (usual) prime <MATH_0013>, then
each of these has the same inverse image in <MATH_0014>.
